guide_lib.book.lookalike.desc: How to use the Disguise Mirror and commands
guide_lib.lookalike.page.overview.text1: Lookalike lets you temporarily disguise your skin as another player. To prevent impersonation, chat names and Tab list names are not changed—only your skin texture updates.
guide_lib.lookalike.page.overview.text2: In multiplayer, you can hide the nametags of all players (when hideAllNametags is enabled in configuration). This allows you to hide completely.
guide_lib.lookalike.page.guide_items.tex: The Lookalike Guide Book is a manual that helps you verify how to use the Disguise Mirror and commands in-game. You can craft it using a book and an amethyst shard.
guide_lib.lookalike.page.mirror.text1: Press and hold Right-click with the Disguise Mirror to open the radial menu. Shift+Right-click another player to scan and record their skin to the radial menu options (up to 8 slots).
guide_lib.lookalike.page.mirror.text2:
The Disguise Mirror can be crafted with the following recipe.

*Note: If 'Enable Disguise Mirror Crafting' is disabled on the server, the recipe will be inactive and you won't be able to craft the mirror in survival mode.
guide_lib.lookalike.page.commands.text1:
If you have GM (OP) permissions, you can use these commands to disguise indefinitely:

- /lookalike disguise <player> <target>
- /lookalike clear <player>

If the nickname MOD is active on the server, you can input a player's nickname to look like them (nicknames are prioritized over real names/UUIDs).
lookalike.config.disguiseDurationSeconds: Specify the duration in seconds before the disguise automatically expires.
If enabled, other players on the server will automatically appear in the radial menu. If disabled, only pre-scanned players are shown.
lookalike.config.hideAllNametags.tooltip: If enabled, hides the overhead nametags of all players in multiplayer.
lookalike.config.enableMirrorCrafting.to: If enabled, players can craft the Disguise Mirror in survival mode.
Cast delay before disguise applies when using the Disguise Mirror. 0 for instant disguise.
lookalike.config.defaultEffectTemplate.t: Particle and sound template during cast (WITCH_SMOKE, ENDER, PORTAL, NONE).
